author: Good Enough
description:
WASP-12 b is being slowly destroyed by its own star. This extreme exoplanet orbits so close to its host star that powerful tidal forces are stretching the planet out of shape while its superheated atmosphere is being pulled away into space.

Astronomers believe WASP-12 b is gradually losing material to its star, making it one of the most dramatic examples of a planet being torn apart by its own solar system. This Short explores WASP-12 b, extreme exoplanets, tidal forces, hot Jupiters, alien worlds, and what happens when a planet gets too close to its star.
title: This Planet is Being Eaten by Its Own Star 🪐😰 #space #galaxy #exoplanets #astronomy
